newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar closes steady against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar closes steady against dollar.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed steady at 496.50-497.50 to the dollar on Thursday, held up by steady Central Bank offering against a five-day weaker trend, traders said.
Corporate, interbank and speculative buyers provided continuing high demand for dollars, but traders said most orders were covered by the Bank.
The bolivar has weakened by almost 10 bolivars, or two percent, in the last month.
"There was some nervous buying by individuals and companies that prefer to be in dollars at the moment, because holding bolivars does not look viable," a trader said.
"There was also a large order from a bank for up to 498 bolivars, but it came off again because the Bank intervened heavily," he added.
